level.why: 句子短而直接，多為 Let's look at、You can see 等簡報固定句型與祈使句；但包含 telescoping、resistance、carry cot、dimensions 等產品與規格字彙，且需整合磁鐵與插銷分工、摺疊步驟、提籃及三種相容配件等多項細節，屬於 B1+ 程度。

passage:
This slide shows the Magic Connect unit.

There are four magnets in the Magic Connect unit and another four on the bottom of the seat. They help guide the seat into the correct position.

Then, two locking pins secure the seat to the frame.

So, the magnets help with alignment, while the two locking pins keep the seat securely in place.

Here, you can see the rear-facing seat in both the upright and fully reclined positions.

Next, let's look at the button on the handlebar that activates the four-wheel swivel function.

The handlebar also has a telescoping adjustment button.

Twist the center button on the handlebar to unlock it and adjust its height.

When the handlebar reaches its lowest position, you'll feel some resistance. Push it a little further to release the frame lock. This allows you to fold the stroller.

Next, let's take a look at the folding process.

This animation shows the folding steps one by one, so you can see how the stroller folds.

Here are the overall dimensions of the stroller in both the folded and unfolded positions.

We've also developed a carry cot that's compatible with Magic Connect.

As you can see, it uses the same Magic Connect system, so you can attach it directly to the stroller frame.

The carry cot can also be folded together with the stroller or folded on its own.

To fold it on its own, simply pull the two buttons, one on each side of the frame tubes, and then fold the carry cot up.

To unfold it, just pull the buttons again and unfold the carry cot.

With Magic Connect, the stroller frame is compatible with three options: the stroller seat, the carry cot, and the car seat.

All three use the same Magic Connect connection system.

We'll discuss the car seat in more detail later.

Finally, let's take a look at the key features and specifications of the stroller.

The stroller is designed for children from birth up to 22 kilograms.

It features the Magic Connect system, one-hand folding, and an adjustable handlebar and reclining seat.

It's also lightweight and compact, weighing just 7.5 kilograms.

That's it for the Magic Connect presentation. Thank you.

Do you have any questions?
zh:
這張投影片展示的是 Magic Connect 組件。

Magic Connect 組件裡有四顆磁鐵，座椅底部還有另外四顆。它們能幫助引導座椅到正確的位置。

接著，兩根鎖定插銷會把座椅固定在車架上。

所以，磁鐵負責對位，而兩根鎖定插銷則讓座椅牢牢固定在定位。

在這裡，你可以看到面朝後的座椅在直立與完全後躺兩種位置的樣子。

接下來，我們來看推把上用來啟動四輪旋轉功能的按鈕。

推把上也有一個伸縮調整按鈕。

轉動推把中央的按鈕即可解鎖，並調整推把的高度。

當推把降到最低位置時，你會感覺到一些阻力。再多推一點，就能解除車架鎖定。這樣你就能摺疊推車。

接下來，我們來看摺疊的過程。

這段動畫一步一步展示摺疊的步驟，讓大家看到推車是如何摺疊的。

這是推車在摺疊與展開兩種狀態下的整體尺寸。

我們也開發了一款與 Magic Connect 相容的提籃。

如同各位所見，它使用相同的 Magic Connect 系統，所以可以直接安裝到推車車架上。

提籃可以和推車一起摺疊，也可以單獨摺疊。

要單獨摺疊它，只要拉動兩個按鈕，也就是車架管兩側各一個，然後把提籃向上摺起即可。

要展開它，只要再次拉動按鈕，把提籃展開就可以了。

有了 Magic Connect，推車車架可以搭配三種選項：推車座椅、提籃，以及汽車安全座椅。

這三種都使用相同的 Magic Connect 連接系統。

關於汽車安全座椅，我們稍後會更詳細地討論。

最後，我們來看這台推車的主要特色與規格。

這台推車適用於從出生到 22 公斤的孩童。

它具備 Magic Connect 系統、單手摺疊，以及可調式推把與可後躺的座椅。

它也輕巧又緊湊，重量只有 7.5 公斤。

以上就是 Magic Connect 的簡報。謝謝大家。

大家有任何問題嗎？

vocab.col: folding carry cot / attach a carry cot
vocab.zh: 提籃式嬰兒睡床（可安裝在推車上）

vocab.col: check one by one / explain one by one

questions.q: According to the speaker, what do the magnets in the Magic Connect unit do?
opts: They lock the seat to the frame
They release the rear wheel swivel locks
They help guide the seat into the correct position
They hold the carry cot closed when folded
why: 錯誤：把座椅固定在車架上的是兩根鎖定插銷，不是磁鐵。
錯誤：解除後輪旋轉鎖要按住推把上的按鈕，與磁鐵無關。
正解：講者說磁鐵幫助引導座椅到正確位置，負責對位，鎖定則由兩根插銷處理。
錯誤：全文沒有提到磁鐵用來固定摺疊後的提籃。

questions.q: How can the carry cot be folded on its own?
opts: By pulling the two buttons on the frame tubes and folding it up
By twisting the center button on the handlebar
By pushing the handlebar a little further down
By removing it from the stroller and pressing the car seat button
why: 正解：講者說單獨摺疊時，只要拉動車架管兩側各一個的兩個按鈕，再把提籃向上摺起。
錯誤：轉動推把中央按鈕是用來解鎖並調整推把高度。
錯誤：把推把再往下推是為了解除車架鎖定，用於摺疊推車。
錯誤：文中沒有這樣的步驟，而且汽車安全座椅不是提籃的摺疊機構。

questions.q: Which items can be attached to the stroller frame with the Magic Connect system?
opts: A stroller seat and a carry cot only
A carry cot and a car seat only
A car seat and a footrest
A stroller seat, a carry cot, and a car seat
why: 錯誤：除了座椅和提籃，還有汽車安全座椅也相容。
錯誤：還漏掉了推車座椅，它同樣使用 Magic Connect。
錯誤：文中沒有提到腳踏板，而且漏掉座椅與提籃。
正解：講者說車架與推車座椅、提籃及汽車安全座椅三種選項相容，且都用相同的連接系統。

questions.q: The samples will be shipped to our client ______ the end of the week.
opts: during
by
since
among
why: 錯誤：during 後面接一段期間，不用於表示截止時間點。
正解：by 表示「在……之前、最遲到……」，by the end of the week 指最晚在週末前。
錯誤：since 用於從過去某時間點到現在，與未來式 will be shipped 不搭。
錯誤：among 表示「在……之間」，不能用來表示時間。

questions.q: The security system will automatically ______ the door when an employee scans a badge.
opts: unlocking
unlocked
unlock
unlocks
why: 錯誤：will 後面要接動詞原形，不能接 -ing 形式。
錯誤：will 後面不能接過去式或過去分詞。
正解：will automatically 後接動詞原形 unlock，表示將自動開鎖。
錯誤：will 之後動詞不加 -s，unlocks 的第三人稱單數形不適用。

questions.q: Employees must install the new software ______ the instructions in the manual.
opts: according to
because of
instead of
in spite of
why: 正解：according to 表示「依照、根據」，符合依手冊說明安裝的語意。
錯誤：because of 表示原因，語意不通順。
錯誤：instead of 表示「而不是」，不符合句意。
錯誤：in spite of 表示「儘管」，與句意相反。

presentation_phrases.phrase: This slide shows the Magic Connect unit.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這張投影片展示的是 Magic Connect 組件。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報開場，說明這一頁投影片要介紹的對象。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Next, let's look at the button on the handlebar.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接下來，我們來看推把上的按鈕。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉到下一個零件或功能時的過渡句。

presentation_phrases.phrase: This animation shows the folding steps one by one.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這段動畫一步一步展示摺疊的步驟。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於播放動畫或影片，說明操作流程。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Here are the overall dimensions of the stroller.
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於展示規格與尺寸資料。

presentation_phrases.phrase: We've also developed a carry cot that's compatible with Magic Connect.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們也開發了一款與 Magic Connect 相容的提籃。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於介紹延伸或搭配產品。

presentation_phrases.phrase: We'll discuss the car seat in more detail later.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 關於汽車安全座椅，我們稍後會更詳細地討論。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於預告後面會說明的內容，避免現在離題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Finally, let's take a look at the key features and specifications.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 最後，我們來看主要特色與規格。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報最後階段，整理產品重點與規格。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That's it for the presentation. Do you have any questions?
presentation_phrases.meaning: 簡報到此結束。大家有任何問題嗎？
